title: Inzwi reUchenjeri
intro: Izwi reuchenjeri raimbopiwa zano rinopfuura nguva. Munhu uyu, akakomborerwa nekunzwisisa kwakadzama, akapa zvidzidzo zvinokosha zvinoramba zviri chiedza kune vese vanoda kutungamirirwa. Unogona here kutsanangura hunhu huri shure kwemashoko aya anogara kwenguva refu?
clues: Ndakapihwa chikomborero chikuru kubva kuna Allah, chipo chakavhenekera moyo wangu nepfungwa dzangu.
Ndakatendeukira kumwana wangu wandinoda, ndichida kugovana pfuma inokosha zvikuru yandaiva nayo.
Ndakanyevera kuti kusaruramisira kukuru ndekwekubatana naMwari mumwe chete wechokwadi.
Ndakayeuchidza kuti kunyange huremu hwembeu yemasitadhi, yakavanzwa mudombo kana mhiri kwedenga, ichaunzwa kuna Allah.
Ndakarayira kuti titeerere vabereki, kunyange zvazvo kuteerera kuri munyaya dzekururama chete.
Ndakadzidzisa tsika dziri nyore: famba uchizvininipisa pasi uye dzora inzwi rako; nekuti ruzha rwakanyanya kurwadza ndiko kuchema kwembongoro.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
